\documentclass{article}
% In TeX, the two letters in this macro body are separate math atoms: p x.
\newcommand{\px}{px}
\begin{document}
For real momentum $p$ and coordinate $x$, the following is only a
rearrangement of three copies of $p x$.
\begin{equation}
  \px + \px + px = \px + px + px
\end{equation}
\end{document}
